name: Puretrop Fruits Limited
summary: Puretrop Fruits Limited specializes in the international export of processed fruits and vegetables, supplying them to supermarket chains across India and globally. Its extensive product portfolio features various fruit pulps and concentrates, including mango, pomegranate, guava, and watermelon. The company also manufactures cold-pressed fruit and vegetable juices, alongside nut milk. Additional offerings comprise tomato and amla pulps, as well as frozen and high-pressure processed (HPP) frozen pulps of pomegranate, mango, and guava, with organic product selections also available. Founded in 1992 and based in Ahmedabad, India, the firm changed its name to Puretrop Fruits Limited in October 2024, having previously been known as Freshtrop Fruits Limited.
